bull_bear.body:
- Market and price volatility risk — Explicitly listed first in the MD&A 'Risks and Concerns' section and repeated under Threats. Because the Company is primarily engaged in investment activities and its financial performance is stated to be driven by investment activities and market conditions, capital-market price swings pass through directly to results with no operating business to absorb them. The Outlook section concedes the capital markets present challenges 'due to inherent volatility'.
- Regulatory and compliance risk — Listed in MD&A Risks and Concerns and again under Threats as 'Regulatory changes impacting financial services'. This is not theoretical for this company — the Secretarial Auditor recorded two live Section 203 non-compliances during the year.
- Unfilled statutory Key Managerial Personnel positions — The Secretarial Audit Report (Form MR-3) qualifies that no Managing Director / Chief Executive Officer / Manager was appointed after Mr. Jatinder Bagga resigned w.e.f. 24.09.2025, and that the Company Secretary & Compliance Officer vacancy from Mr. Ashish Mehta's resignation w.e.f. 14.07.2025 remained unfilled as at the report date — non-compliance with Section 203 of the Companies Act, 2013 and Regulation 6(1) of SEBI (LODR), 2015. A listed entity running without an MD/CEO leaves executive accountability and regulatory-interface capacity structurally thin.
- Liquidity and funding risk — Named in both the MD&A Threats list and the Risks and Concerns list. It sits against an offsetting opportunity the Company itself cites — 'improved access to diversified funding sources' — and against a preferential issue whose allotment was still pending at the report date, so the funding is committed on paper but not yet received.
- Change in control and management of the Company — The Directors' Report records that, pursuant to completion of the open offer for 31,52,994 (26%) equity shares by Mr. Rajesh Ghosh and Dorni Vinimoy Private Limited under SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011, there has been a change in the control and management of the Company, with a newly classified Promoter and Promoter Group. A change of control resets strategy, board composition and capital-allocation intent, and the associated preferential allotment remained pending.
- Single-activity concentration with no operating segments — The MD&A states the Company is primarily engaged in investment activities and that segment-wise reporting is 'not applicable', and the Company had no subsidiary companies during the year under review. With one activity, no segment diversification and no subsidiary base, there is nothing to cushion a downturn in the single exposure.
- Competitive intensity in financial services — Listed under MD&A Threats as 'Competition from established and emerging players'. The Company discloses no moat, brand, distribution or scale advantage anywhere in the routed text to set against established competitors.
- Economic and geopolitical uncertainty — Named in the MD&A Risks and Concerns list and echoed in the Cautionary Statement, which warns actual results may differ materially depending on economic conditions, changes in government regulations and tax laws.
